name.ja: 鬼滅模型 嘴平伊之助

ja: 簡単組み立て×ハイクオリティが融合した鬼滅模型に嘴平伊之助がラインアップ！
■頭部の差し替えで素顔の状態も再現。瞳や眉はタンポ印刷を採用。
■猪頭の瞳や耳はシール、鼻は彩色パーツで表現。
■髪の“うねり“や“なびき“の様子を立体的に表現。毛先の色分けは塗装済パーツで再現。
■日輪刀の刀身も再現。筋肉や毛皮も細部までこだわりの造形で追求。
en: Inosuke Tsukihira is now available as a Demon Slayer model that combines easy assembly and high quality!
• The real face can be recreated by replacing the head. The eyes and eyebrows use tampo printing.
• The eyes and ears of the boar head are expressed with seals, and the nose is expressed with colored parts.
• Three-dimensional representation of the undulations and fluttering of hair. The color coding of the tips of the hair is reproduced with painted parts.
• The blade of the ring sword is also reproduced. Muscles and fur are also sculpted with great attention to detail.

ja: 素顔パーツ(タンポ印刷)×1
